I wanted to know,

How much time do you take to copy each frame? Although this production video is in fast motion, I am genuinely intrigued by how you draw each frame that fast (if put at normal speed).

I once thought of becoming an animator, and still think of pursuing it. What software do you use to draw, and do you use your mouse to draw? 

I am pretty slow to tasks, and hearing the Japanese animators not having much time to rest, I can assume that drawing each frame is to be done fast.
